memory_update.text: MIDD and ITW are reference anchors for restaurant commercial kitchen equipment plus installed-base service; do not let them crowd out smaller discovery names in later layers.
HBB is a below-USD-300M speculative exception: commercial foodservice equipment exposure exists, but recurring service/parts economics and restaurant-channel purity must be verified before promotion.
WSO is not a pure restaurant asset, but HVAC/R parts distribution could be a hidden restaurant uptime layer through commercial refrigeration contractors and refrigerant-transition replacement demand.

Many pure-play kitchen repair, OEM-parts and technician-network assets appear private, including General Parts, Tech24, Parts Town, Smart Care and regional CFESA service firms; public-market exposure is mostly indirect.
FARM should be removed from the current US-listed discovery universe after the May 2026 take-private closing, despite strong node fit as a coffee roaster, distributor and equipment servicer.

node: Commercial kitchen, beverage, refrigeration, and equipment service networks
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around restaurant equipment uptime rather than restaurant brands. The strongest public mappings are equipment OEMs with installed-base service networks and refrigeration/HVAC-R distributors. The underfollowed lane is thin because many pure-play service networks and parts distributors are private, so public candidates require careful exposure verification. No buy/sell recommendation is implied.
